rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Nushuz derives from elevation or a mound: the wife acts as if superior and withdraws obedience.

rows.speaker: İbn Abbas
rows.claim: Ibn Abbas defines a wife's nushuz as disobedience to her husband.
rows.anchor: kadının nüşûzu zevcine isyanı (İbn Abbas), koku sürünmemesi

rows.speaker: Atâ
rows.claim: Atā says nushuz includes not perfuming herself, refusing her husband intimacy, or changing how she previously treated him.
rows.anchor: koku sürünmemesi, zevcini nefsinden men‘etmesi, mukaddemâ zevcine yaptığı muâmeleyi değiştirmesi (Atâ)

rows.speaker: Ebû Mansur
rows.claim: Abu Mansur describes nushuz as the wife disliking her husband.
rows.anchor: zevcini hoşlanmaması (Ebû Mansur), zevcinin mesken-i şer‘î olarak

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Another reported definition is refusing to live with the husband in the lawful residence he assigned, or living somewhere he dislikes.
rows.anchor: zevcinin mesken-i şer‘î olarak tâyin ettiği ikāmetgâhta beraber oturmaktan imtinâ‘edip onun arzu etmediği bir yerde ikāmet etmesi

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The response proceeds in order: counsel, leave them apart in bed, then strike lightly and without causing shame.
rows.anchor: sâlisen, hafifçe ve şeyn-âver olmayacak bir surette biraz dövüveriniz

words: فَإِنْ أَطَعْنَكُمْ فَلَا تَبْغُوا۟ عَلَيْهِنَّ سَبِيلًا
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: When they obey, husbands must stop seeking grounds to attack them and treat their earlier faults as if they had not happened, like a repentant sinner.
rows.anchor: size itaat ederlerse artık taarruz için aleyhlerinde vesile aramayınız ve vâki‘olan kusurlarını olmamış gibi addediniz

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God's might greatly exceeds a husband's power; men should fear Him and not misuse their authority, especially since God accepts their repentance and forgives them.
rows.anchor: Allah’tan korkunuz da kadınlara karşı size vermiş olduğu kuvveti sû’-i isti‘mâl etmeyiniz, Allah’ın size karşı kudreti sizin kadınlara karşı kuvvetinizden çok yüksektir

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Alternatively, God is exalted above injustice; His majesty requires people to avoid oppression, disloyalty, misconduct, and abusing their duties.
rows.anchor: Allah zulümden ve haksızlıktan müte‘âlî bir sâhib-i kibriyâdır. Binâen‘aleyh O’nun ulüvv-i şân ve kibriyâsı karşısında zulümden

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: If discord threatens while the marriage remains, appoint one arbiter from each spouse's relatives, who know the couple's circumstances and want their welfare.
rows.anchor: biri zevcin akrabasından, biri de zevcenin akrabasından olmak üzere iki hakem gönderiniz. Zira akrabaları onların iç yüzlerini daha iyi bilirler

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Choosing relatives as arbiters is recommended, but appointing outsiders is also permissible.
rows.anchor: akrabadan olmaları müstehab bulunduğu, yoksa ecânibden nasbları da

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The spouses initially have the right to choose the arbiters; consultation with both families is recommended, as the wording indicates.
rows.anchor: Hakemi intihab hakkı evvelâ zevc ve zevceye aittir. Ve bunun her iki taraftan akrabalarının müşaveresiyle yapılması müstehab olacağı

rows.speaker: Hazret-i Ali
rows.claim: One juristic view, transmitted from Ali, lets the arbiters separate the spouses, effecting an irrevocable divorce.
rows.anchor: Bir kısmı tefrik de yapabilirler ve bir talâk-ı bâin olur demişler ki bu Hazret-i Ali’den mervîdir

rows.speaker: Hasan; İmâm-ı A‘zam
rows.claim: Hasan's view, also held by Abu Hanifa, limits the arbiters to reconciliation and denies them authority to separate.
rows.anchor: Bir kısmı da bunlar telife me’murdur, tefrik edemezler demiş ki bu da Hasan’dan mervîdir ve İmâm-ı A‘zam’ın kavlidir

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: There is no dispute if the husband expressly delegates separation authority; the disagreement concerns cases where he has not delegated it.
rows.anchor: Gerçi tefrik salâhiyeti tasrih edildiği, zevc de bunu kabul ve tefviz eylediği takdirde ihtilâf yoktur

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Jurists dispute whether a court may compel full arbitral authority without the husband's delegation, whether arbiters act as spouses' agents or judicial deputies, and whether the court may itself separate them.
rows.anchor: Ancak zevc tefrîke salâhiyet vermediği takdirde

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The verse's context centers reconciliation and leaves separation unaddressed, making arbitral separation a matter of juristic reasoning.
rows.anchor: âyetin siyâkı telif üzerindedir. Tefrikten bahis münâsib görülmeyip meskûtün anh bırakılmış ve bunun için bir ictihad mevzû‘u olmuştur

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: If both arbiters sincerely intend reconciliation, God brings the spouses together and places affection and love in their hearts.
rows.anchor: Allah iki tarafın beynini tevfîk u te’lîf eder. Zevc ve zevcenin kalblerine meveddet ü mahabbet ilkā eyler

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God's knowledge and awareness underscore that He knows how to reconcile them; leaving separation unmentioned signals that divine approval lies with concord, the intended outcome.
rows.anchor: Alîm ve Habîr olan Allah’ın burada tefrik cihetini meskûtün anh bırakması da gayet mânidardır. Demek ki Allah’ın rızâsı şikakta değil, vifaktadır

words: وَإِنِ ٱمْرَأَةٌ خَافَتْ مِنۢ بَعْلِهَا نُشُوزًا
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Men can also show nushuz; the later verse 4:128 will give the related rules and discuss separation.
rows.anchor: Evet, erkekler tarafından da nüşuz olabilir.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: This passage assumes men fulfill their duties of guardianship and concerns family reform; therefore it treats women's nushuz here and reserves men's nushuz for a separate discussion.
rows.anchor: erkeklerin kavvâmiyeti ve mûcebince bütün vazifelerinin îfâsı ve binâen‘aleyh erkek tarafından hiçbir kabahat bulunmadığı takdîri üzerine cereyan ettiğinden

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: After resolving family life, the passage turns to general moral instruction and lays down ten duties.
rows.anchor: aile terbiyesinde umûmî bir ilmihal olarak esas ittihaz edilmesi lâzım gelen ahlâk-ı haseneye geçilerek

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The first duty is to worship God alone and sincerely, associating nothing with Him.
rows.anchor: birincisi, Allah’a ibadet ve ubûdiyet ve O’na hiçbir şey şerîk koşmayıp ihlas ile ibadet etmek

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The second duty is to treat one's mother and father with benevolence.
rows.anchor: ikincisi anaya babaya ihsan ile muâmele etmek

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The third duty is benevolence toward relatives.
rows.anchor: üçüncüsü {وَبِذِى ٱلْقُرْبَىٰ} akrabaya ihsan, dördüncüsü

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The fourth duty is benevolence toward orphans.
rows.anchor: dördüncüsü {وَٱلْيَتَٰمَىٰ} yetimlere ihsan, beşincisi

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The fifth duty is benevolence toward the poor.
rows.anchor: beşincisi {وَٱلْمَسَٰكِينِ} fukarâya ihsan, altıncısı

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The near neighbor is one whose home is nearby or who is a relative.
rows.anchor: yakın komşuya ihsan ki hânesi yakın olur veya akrabadan bulunur

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The distant neighbor may live farther away, be unrelated, or be non-Muslim.
rows.anchor: veya akrabadan olmaz veya gayrimüslim bulunur

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: A Prophetic hadith distinguishes neighbors with three rights (neighbor, kinship, Islam), two rights (neighbor, Islam), and one right (neighbor only), including People of the Book and polytheist neighbors.
rows.anchor: üç hakkı vardır; hakk-ı civar, hakk-ı karâbet, hakk-ı İslâm. İkincisinin iki hakkı vardır; hakk-ı civar

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The companion at one's side is a companion in a good activity such as study, business, craft, or travel; the meaning includes spouses.
rows.anchor: musâhabet eden arkadaş ve yoldaş demektir. Bu mefhum zevc ve zevceye dahi şâmil olur

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The wayfarer is an arriving traveler, or more generally a guest.
rows.anchor: yahut mutlaka dayfa ihsan.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Those under one's hand are people in one's custody, such as male and female slaves.
rows.anchor: köle ve cariye gibi[^22] el altında bulunanlara ihsan

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Muhtal means arrogant; fahur means boastful and vainglorious.
rows.anchor: tefâhur eden demektir ki Allah bunları sevmez, hele o bahil mütekebbirler

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The miserly not only withhold but urge other people to be miserly as well.
rows.anchor: hem kendileri bahillik ederler hem de nâsa buhl emrederler

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Some Jews reportedly urged the Ansar not to spend, warning that they would become poor; this occasioned the verse.
rows.anchor: diye nasihat etmeye kalkışmaları bu âyetin nüzûlüne sebep olmuştur

words: وَيَكْتُمُونَ مَآ ءَاتَىٰهُمُ ٱللَّهُ مِن فَضْلِهِۦ
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: They conceal the wealth and knowledge God gave them from His favor.

rows.anchor: o ümmetin peygamberi olduğu müfessirîn tarafından beyan olunmuştur

words: فَكَيْفَ إِذَا جِئْنَا مِن كُلِّ أُمَّةٍ بِشَهِيدٍ
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The verse asks what will become of the disbelievers on Resurrection Day when a witness is brought from every nation and Muhammad witnesses over them.
rows.anchor: bilir misin her ümmetten bir şâhid getirdiğimiz, yâ Muhammed, seni de o şâhidler üzerine şâhid getirdiğimiz vakit o kıyamet günü o kâfirlerin hâli ne olacak

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Those who disbelieved and disobeyed the Messenger will wish they had been covered level with the earth, leaving no trace.

rows.anchor: ağızları mühürlenecek, elleri ayakları söyleyecektir

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The following discussion develops inner and outer purity: prayer follows faith, purification is prayer's first condition, and major ablution connects closely to marriage and family rules; both require a sound mind.
rows.anchor: tahâret-i bâtına ve zâhire ile وَٱعْبُدُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ emrine bir inkişaf verilmek ve imandan sonra ibadetin akdemi namaz ve namazın ilk şartı da necasetten ve hadesten taharet olduğu

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: A report identifies the occasion of revelation as the banquet incident of Abd al-Rahman ibn Awf, detailed under 2:219.
rows.anchor: Bu âyetin sebeb-i nüzûlü Abdurrahman b. Avf hazretlerinin ziyafeti hâdisesi olduğu mervîdir

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Pairing intoxication with janaba and avoidance with purification eloquently conveys the prohibition and impurity of intoxicants, stated explicitly at 5:90.
rows.anchor: Sarhoşluğun cünüplük ile ve ondan sakınmanın da tahâret ve gusül ile müterâfık olarak mevzû‘-i bahis edilmesi ve bu hâlde mü’minin namaza yaklaşmaktan men‘i

rows.speaker: بعض المفسرين
rows.claim: Some commentators take salat here to mean the mosque or prayer-place, so the prohibition bars drunk people from entering mosques.
rows.anchor: murad mescid ve musallâdır, bununla sarhoşlar mescidlere duhulden men‘edilmişlerdir demiş

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Elmalılı says there is no need to depart from salat's basic meaning: an intoxicated person who cannot understand his words cannot pray validly, and intoxication is forbidden.
rows.anchor: bu mânayı anlamak için salâtı ma‘nâ-yı aslîsinden çıkarmaya lüzum yoktur. Bu nehiy, söylediğini bilmeyen sarhoşun namazı sahih olmadığına

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: By indication, the verse also bars drunk and junub people from entering or even approaching the mosque; the exception for passing through applies only to junub people, not the drunk.
rows.anchor: Demek ki söylediğini bilmez sarhoşların mescid civarından geçmelerine de mesağ yoktur. Çünkü esasen sarhoşluğa mesağ yoktur

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Junub denotes a person in janaba after emission; it can be used as a singular noun or a plural.
rows.anchor: inzal vâki‘olmuş bulunandır ki, masdar gibi müfred veya cem‘e ıtlak olunur

rows.speaker: author

rows.anchor: Gusletmek, yani baştan başa yıkanmaktır

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Abirin sabil means people traveling on the road or in a state of travel; the exception concerns tayammum.
rows.anchor: Yolda gidenler, sefer hâlinde bulunanlar demektir.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The phrase may also permit a junub person to pass along the road beside a mosque, but not enter the mosque; it has no bearing on drunk people.
rows.anchor: sâlihtir. Bu itibar ile de cünübün namaz kılınan mescidden değil, fakat yanındaki yoldan geçmesi câiz olduğuna bir işaret olur

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Ghait means a low hollow place and euphemistically refers to a latrine; coming from it means relieving oneself and having minor ritual impurity.
rows.anchor: engin, çukur yer demek olup halâya işarettir, bundan gelmek de hadesten, abdest bozmaktan kinayedir

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Al-Kisa'i and Khalaf al-Ashir read lamastum without the alif, from lams rather than mulamasah; both forms mean touching women.
rows.anchor: Kisâî, Halef-i Âşir kıraatlerinde elifsiz أَوْ لَٰمَسْتُمُ ٱلنِّسَآءَ okunur.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The wording is agreed to signify intercourse, specifically the meeting of the circumcised parts, which requires ghusl.
rows.anchor: Bunun da sûret-i mahsûsada bir dokunmak demek olan iltikā-i hıtâneyn mânasını ifade ettiğinde ittifak vardır ve gusül îcâb eder

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The Hanafi view, followed by Elmalılı, excludes mere skin contact from the meaning; touching a woman's body alone does not invalidate ablution.
rows.anchor: Biz Hanefiyyece bu maksud değildir. Binâen‘aleyh kadının bir tarafına mücerred dokunuvermekle abdest bozulmaz

rows.speaker: Zâhiriyye
rows.claim: The Zahiris hold that mere touch invalidates ablution, but only for the person who touches, not the person touched.
rows.anchor: Zâhiriyye ve Şâfi‘iyye bozulur, gusül değil fakat abdest almak lâzım gelir demişlerdir

rows.speaker: İmam Şâfiî
rows.claim: Shafi'i holds that mere touch invalidates both people's ablution, without requiring ghusl.
rows.anchor: İmam Şâfiî ise ikisininki de bozulacağına kāil olmuştur

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Elmalılı characterizes the Hanafi approach as lenient and the Shafi'i approach as following stricter precaution.
rows.anchor: Hanefiyye tahfîfe, Şâfi‘iyye de teşdid ve ihtiyâta riayet etmişlerdir

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: When illness or travel accompanies a state requiring ghusl or ablution, and water is unavailable, one may turn to tayammum; illness makes inability to find water include actual or legal inability.
rows.anchor: bulamamak hakikaten veya hükmen bulamamaktan e‘am olmuş oluyor

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Tayammum literally means intending, so intention is intrinsic to it.
rows.anchor: Lügaten kasd demektir, binâen‘aleyh niyetsiz teyemmüm olmaz, mahiyetinde dâhildir

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Sa'id means the earth's surface, including stone and soil, so tayammum on a stone is valid even without dust adhering to the hand.
rows.anchor: de yeryüzü demektir ki taşa toprağa şâmildir.

rows.speaker: İmam Şâfiî
rows.claim: Shafi'i requires at least a little soil or dust to adhere.
rows.anchor: İmam Şâfiî birazcık olsun toprak bulaşmalı demiştir

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Tayyib means thoroughly clean, excluding contaminated or doubtful material.
rows.anchor: tertemiz demektir. Binâen‘aleyh mülevves veya şüpheli olmamalıdır

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The practical method is to strike the earth once and wipe the face, then strike again and wipe both hands up to the elbows.

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The concession teaches that inward purity is foundational, but outward cleanliness also matters; neither can replace the other.
rows.anchor: Tahâret-i kalbiye asıldır. Kalbi pis olan ne yapsa temizlenemez

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: In necessity, tayammum is primarily an inward act that preserves the material condition and outward form as fully as possible.
rows.anchor: teyemmüm esasen bir tahâret-i kalbiye işi olmakla beraber şart-ı maddî ve şekl-i zâhirînin de مَا لاَ يُدْرَكُ كُل ُّهُ لاَ يـُتـْرَكُ كُل ُّهُ medlûlü üzere en güzel bir muhafazasıdır

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God's pardon explains the tayammum concession; it does not license intoxication or neglecting purification.
rows.anchor: Bunun için teyemmüme de ruhsat verir. Fakat sarhoşluğa ve cenâbet durmaya müsaade etmez

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The discussion moves from sound mind and bodily and spiritual purity toward intellectual and moral education, then draws attention to the conduct of misguided aggressors.
rows.anchor: muhâfaza-i akl ü şuura ve tahâret-i maddiye ve mâneviyeye müntehî olmakla bilhassa terbiye-i akliye ve fikriyeye revnak ve ahlâk u diyânete metanet verilmek

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: A report says Jewish leaders Huyay ibn Akhtab and Ka'b ibn Ashraf traveled to Mecca with seventy Jewish horsemen to make an alliance with Quraysh and break their pact with the Prophet.
rows.anchor: Huyey b. Ahtab ile Ka‘b b. Eşref ma‘iyyetlerine Yehûddan yetmiş süvari alarak Mekke’ye gitmişler ve Kureyş ile bir ittifak ve mu‘âhede akdederek Resûlullah ile olan ahidlerini nakz etmek istemişlerdi

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Quraysh asked the Jews to prostrate to their idols as proof of trust, saying they could not rely on them because they were People of Scripture and closer to Muhammad.
rows.anchor: siz ehl-i kitabsınız, Muhammed’e bizden daha yakınsınız. Binâen‘aleyh biz size emin olamayız, bizim mâbudlarımıza secde ediniz de mutmain olalım

rows.claim: Abu Sufyan asked Ka'b which path was right; after hearing that Muhammad called only to worship God and reject idolatry, Ka'b praised Quraysh's own religious services and judged their path better.
